title: Sant Tukaram
creator_or_artist: Vishnupant Govind Damle & Sheikh Fattelal (Prabhat Film Co.)
description: Venice Film Festival winner capturing the life of poet-saint Tukaram, shown continuously in Pune revival theatres throughout the 60s.
emotional_resonance_reason: Deep connection to Prabhat Film Company heritage in Pune; peaceful, contemplative pacing ideal for dementia care.

title: Pinjra
description: Landmark color Marathi film by V. Shantaram featuring iconic music by Ram Kadam, starring Shriram Lagoo and Sandhya.
emotional_resonance_reason: Vivid nostalgic soundtrack and cultural stage familiarity from early adult cinema outings in Maharashtra.

title: Jagte Raho
description: Crystal Globe winning masterpiece starring Raj Kapoor; features classic song 'Jaago Mohan Pyare' by Lata Mangeshkar.
emotional_resonance_reason: Lata Mangeshkar's morning raga song in the climax evokes deeply comforting nostalgic security.

title: The Sound of Music
description: Oscar-winning musical phenomenon of 1965 with unforgettable Rodgers and Hammerstein songs.
emotional_resonance_reason: Gentle, uplifted melodic structure with clear visual contrasts; widely proven in clinical music therapy for memory recall.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description: Academy Award winning drama scored by Quincy Jones, featuring Ray Charles performing the title theme.
emotional_resonance_reason: Quincy Jones' blues-infused cinematic score resonates deeply with mid-century jazz and mystery enthusiasts.

title: A Raisin in the Sun
description: Intimate drama set specifically on the South Side of Chicago in the 1950s-60s, starring Sidney Poitier and Claudia McNeil.
emotional_resonance_reason: Direct depiction of mid-century Chicago neighborhood architecture, radio culture, and home life.
